description: This file defines the ReaderProvider class for managing book reading state in a Flutter application. It handles loading book details, navigating chapters, and adding bookmarks, interacting with storage and book services.

classes.name: ReaderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the current reading state including book details, chapter navigation, content, progress, and bookmarks.

methods.name: ReaderProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the storage service and book service.

methods.name: openBook
methods.description: Loads the book details and the current chapter based on a composed ID, updating the internal state accordingly.

methods.name: _loadChapter
methods.description: Internal method that loads the content of the current chapter.

methods.name: nextChapter
methods.description: Advances to the next chapter if available, updates the reading progress.

methods.name: prevChapter
methods.description: Goes back to the previous chapter if possible, updates the reading progress.

methods.name: addBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark at a specified position with an optional note and updates the local state.
